Extremely frustrated
Feb 2026 • Solo
I had breakfast at Basilico for several consecutive days, and overall the experience was disappointing. The food was average and inconsistent, and what frustrated me most was the complete absence of any manager during my visits. There was no one in a leadership position available to explain or address concerns.
That said, the restaurant staff were very nice and clearly tried their best. I am completely satisfied with their attitude and effort. They were polite, attentive, and professional within their capacity. However, without proper management presence, it felt like there was no accountability or clear standard being maintained. For a restaurant that positions itself as upscale, I expected stronger management support.

Totally disappointing
Aug 2025 • Family
I spend part of my time in HCMC and have been to this restaurant many times. Since the change from Intercontinental to JW Marriott the quality of the food has gone down tremendously. We ordered the Insalata Caprese (i.e., tomato - mozarella). Instead of the San Marzano tomatoes, they were from Dalat, and the mozarella had never seen Italy! No taste! This is a complete disgrace to Italian gastronomy! Tha pasta sauce was far from what it used to be and what it should be: too watery, no flavor. 
Did the change in management lead to cost savings? Well this is not reflected in the price charged.
No longer my place to go for Italian cuisine
One of the main course came together with the appetizers, while the others came later!

Expectations not met: disappointing
Aug 2025 • Couples
As an Italian I thought I would find in this restaurant flavors that would make me feel at home but expectations have foundered to the first, which was what should have been linguine with tomato sauce. Everything was completely wrong, starting from the type of pasta that was absolutely not a linguina but more like a noodle, to the flavors of the tomato that were evidently contaminated by some particular ingredient that I could not identify, to close with the really excessive presence of pepper that was not mentioned at all among the ingredients.
The starter of good quality cold cuts and cheeses and the tiramisu also good put a patch to dinner. 

Friendly and professional staff.
